title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: card flavor text

entities.name: Aang
entities.description: The Avatar and last Airbender, born at the Southern Air Temple, who returned when the world needed him most.

entities.name: Zuko
entities.description: A banished Fire Nation prince sent to capture the Avatar to regain his honor, who later becomes Fire Lord and declares the war over.

entities.name: Azula
entities.description: Zuko's sister, a skilled and deadly Fire Nation warrior and would-be Fire Lord whose true passion is emotional torment.

entities.name: Katara
entities.description: A Waterbender who learned skills from a scroll stolen from pirates and carries a waterskin for bending and healing.

entities.name: Sokka
entities.description: A Water Tribe fighter with a trusty boomerang who names Team Avatar's squads and trains children.

entities.name: Toph Beifong
entities.description: A blind Earthbender who sees by feeling vibrations in the earth and calls herself the greatest Earthbender in the world.

entities.name: Iroh
entities.description: A wise Firebender who learned to redirect lightning and favors the white lotus gambit.

entities.name: Ozai
entities.description: The cruel Fire Lord, father of Zuko and Azula.

entities.name: Suki
entities.description: A Kyoshi Warrior.

entities.name: Mai

entities.name: Ty Lee

entities.name: Hakoda

entities.name: Avatar Yangchen

events.summary: Zuko is banished for disobedience and sent to capture the Avatar.
events.quote: As punishment for his disobedience, Zuko was banished and sent to capture the Avatar.

events.summary: Aang evades Zuko using Airbender tactics.
events.quote: Aang employed the typical Airbender tactics against Zuko: avoid and evade.

events.summary: Azula confronts her brother Zuko in a destined showdown.
events.quote: Just you and me, brother. The showdown that was always meant to be.

events.summary: Jeong Jeong's followers desert the Fire Nation.
events.quote: To leave the Fire Nation required incredible trust. They had that in Jeong Jeong.

events.summary: Hakoda announces the invasion plan to defeat the Fire Lord and end the war.
events.quote: When this is finished, the Avatar will have defeated the Fire Lord, we will have control of the Fire Nation capital, and this war will be over!

events.summary: Katara steals the Waterbending Scroll from pirates and learns from it.
events.quote: The scroll taught Katara many useful skills. So did fighting the angry pirates she stole it from.

events.summary: On the Day of Black Sun, Team Avatar uses the eclipse to storm the Fire Nation capital.
events.quote: The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.

events.summary: Azula is defeated and breaks down.
events.quote: With Azula's defeat, all of her nobility, grace, and confidence shattered into harrowing screams from the would-be Fire Lord.

events.summary: Mai defies Azula out of love for Zuko.
events.quote: You miscalculated. I love Zuko more than I fear you.

events.summary: Haru is punished for a good deed.
events.quote: Haru's good deed went severely punished.

events.summary: Zuko hires Combustion Man to kill the Avatar.
events.quote: The Avatar's alive. I want you to find him, and end him.

events.summary: Zuko's journey began refusing to duel his father and ends dueling his sister.
events.quote: Zuko's journey began when he refused to duel his father, but it would end dueling his sister.

events.summary: Ty Lee leaves the circus to follow Azula.
events.quote: The circus called to Ty Lee . . . until Azula called a little louder.

events.summary: After the moon spirit's death, Aang and La destroy the Fire Nation fleet.
events.quote: With the death of the moon spirit, the Avatar's tides of vengeance crashed over the Fire Nation fleet.

events.summary: The Avatar returns when the world needs him most.
events.quote: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

events.summary: Fire Lord Zuko declares the war over.
events.quote: Today, this war is finally over!

events.summary: Aang searches the depths for Koh's home.
events.quote: Aang delved deep into the spiraling depths in search of wherever Koh called home.
